newsitem.title: USA: AT&T Capital files for $4.0 bln shelf debt.
newsitem.headline: AT&T Capital files for $4.0 bln shelf debt.

text.p: AT&T Capital Corp filed a shelf registration on Friday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $4.0 billion in debt securities and warrants to purchase debt securities.

AT&T Capital, an equipment leasing company that was sold off by AT&T Corp earlier this year, said net proceeds will be used to finance installment sale and lease agreements to buyers of equipment made by Lucent Technologies Inc and NCR Corp. Lucent was spun off by AT&T and NCR is expected to be spun off shortly.
No underwriters were listed in the filing.
